name: French Medieval Fabric Dining Chandelier (scalloped pleated fabric bell, off-white, 45 cm)
texture: fine vertical micro-pleats in eight soft petal panels, scalloped hem; a cream ball finial on top

nordic.reason: נפסל. בתמונות (img/r3/sheet-2601120857281610500.jpg) הכיפה, השרוול שמתחת לכדור והחרוז בתחתית בכרום מבריק, וכרום אסור בתלויה. הכיפה מופיעה בסרטוני היציאה, והחרוז נראה מלמטה. שפת 'עלי הכותרת' המסולסלת והכדור הקרמי הם שפה צרפתית-רומנטית ולא נורדית. בצד החיובי: מידות 45×30 ומפזר תחתון נראה.

boho.reason: פעמון קפלים רומנטי בשמנת, מתאים לפינת אוכל בבוהו רך. אבל הכרום פוגע גם שם.

notes: Single variant vid 2601120857281610700 ('Warm Light Beige', 45 cm), $29.52, sku CJYD272605101AZ. Dimensions from the supplier's drawing: diameter 45, shade height 30, hanging wire 150 cm adjustable, canopy 10 cm, light source E27 x3 (inside one shade). SHIPPING to IL: cheapest = CJPacket Eub 12-50 d $35.88 (in the shipping field); no reasonable fast option: CJPacket Sensitive 22-27 d $232.35, CJPacket To Door 11-18 d $237.00, DHL Official 3-7 d $530.10 (bulky carton 48x48x30). listedNum 11 (low). ELECTRICAL: description says 'Voltage: 220V'; CE NOT mentioned - not verified. Hardwired canopy, no plug. GAPS vs the Bible: (1) the canopy, the cord sleeve under the ball and a small bead at the bottom centre look polished chrome/silver in the photos - chrome is forbidden in the pendant; the canopy is out of frame in the main view but appears in exit videos, and the bottom bead is visible from below - master-designer must decide whether it is acceptable or must be swapped/painted (we cannot modify supplier stock). (2) Bottom: photos 2 and 4 show a flat white disc inside the hem with the bead at its centre, i.e. a bottom diffuser seems present - not stated in text; confirm. (3) Scalloped 'petal' hem gives a slightly romantic French-vintage read; shape still within 'soft pleated bell'. (4) Colour: creamy white per drawing; reads warm white in the plain photo, more oatmeal in the warm-lit room photos. Copy check: no designer or brand named in the listing; scalloped pleated fabric bell pendants are sold widely, but master-designer should confirm it is not read as a specific design. Requires installation by an electrician.
